record.question: They are very grateful __________ your kindness.
record.explanation: Answer A: for. Grateful for describes the reason/object of gratitude; grateful to normally identifies its recipient (A). Independent check: “Grateful for” introduces the thing/reason one is thankful for; “your kindness” is that reason. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/grateful.
